item.title: Audit Flags 17 Fixes for Montclair Schools Finances as $17.6M Tax Vote Nears
item.description: An annual audit of the Montclair Public Schools presented Wednesday details 17 “recommendations” for corrective action – seven of them “material weaknesses” – including over-expenditures, losses in the food service fund and multiple issues with paying bills. The audit for 2024-25 comes with a new administration in place. The post Audit Flags 17 Fixes for Montclair Schools Finances as $17.6M Tax Vote Nears appeared first on Montclair Local.

item.title: Newark Mayor Condemns ICE After Pursuit Ends in Crash With Children Inside
item.description: "ICE has no business engaging in chases at any time, anywhere – but especially in densely populated areas, and on roads still being cleared from a significant snowstorm. item.title: Brendan Gill Will Not Seek Reelection As County Commissioner
item.description: In an interview Friday, Gill said he decided not to run for reelection so he could spend more time with his family and focus on his public affairs business. While he had no plans to stop being an active Democrat, Gill said he would not be seeking elected office for the foreseeable future. The post Brendan Gill Will Not Seek Reelection As County Commissioner appeared first on Montclair Local.
